title: Privacy: readers of the store's record do not check that it predates an erase
evidence: The root gap behind N1, S46 and S49. RecordStore.predatesErase (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:52) marks a record the store holds that was not shown after the last erase, and RecordStore.showErased (:336-342) leaves it set when the erase came with no record to draw. Only the charts (RecordStore+Charts.swift:13, 19, 30, 53, 60) and the metric page (MetricDetailView.swift:161) check it. These read store.recordJSON or store.myData with no check: the chat context (ChatView.swift:241), Export (RecordSection.swift:12), the reminders read (HealthRoadmapApp.swift:182, refreshed on every record change by RootView.swift:124), the Apple Health write-back (AppleHealthSync.swift:372), and the My data rows (RecordStore.swift:27 myData, read across MyDataView.swift). An erase held with no record can therefore reach the chat, an export, a reminder schedule or Apple Health with the pre-erase record. US-25 AC16f, AC16g, AC16h
